exact.method: Per-vertex dependency DAG and bit-identical scalar-field batching; no lerp factorization, curve fitting, vertex reduction, texture or order changes

precision.method: Native skeleton constant-lerp factorization, then per-vertex dependency DAG batching; changes floating-point drift, requires Blender ground-truth verification

exact_evaluation.method: Two unmodified pinned Ayagami drivers, identical parameter sequence, every vertex including hidden carriers; timings interleaved before/after, CPU only

precision_evaluation.method: Two unmodified pinned Ayagami drivers, identical parameter sequence, every vertex including hidden carriers; timings interleaved before/after, CPU only

timing.note: Identical 60-pose wave/laugh/walk sequence, five warmup frames per process. ABBA ordering. Native parameter evaluation through GPU completion at 768x1024, full-size masks, reused cleared output target; no image readback in timing. Separate paired CPU-only drivers with input order reversed. Desktop not isolated. Not a real-time FPS claim.

source_reference: Reused independent Blender source geometry/images from the unchanged fullbody baseline, same parameter cases and camera; no new Blender mutations
